# **Platform Overview**

Liquio is an innovative GovTech platform that leverages artificial intelligence and a low-code approach to drive the digital transformation of public services. It enables rapid creation, configuration, and deployment of a wide range of IT solutions, and web and mobile applications for government agencies and local governments.

Liquio is recognized internationally and listed in the GovStack Global Software Catalogue, meeting global standards for government digital transformation.

The platform is developed and supported by Kitsoft, a leading GovTech company. For more than 11 years Kitsoft has specialized in designing and delivering digital ecosystems and public services for governments and municipalities. The company is originally from Ukraine, and has offices in Brussels and Berlin.

# **Why Liquio?**

* **Open source edition**
  Liquio Community Edition enables governments to keep control of the product and  ensures digital sovereignty by providing transparent, open-source technology that internal teams can own, adapt, and scale according to national priorities.
* **Low-code approach** 
  By minimizing complex coding, low-code enables analysts and service designers to focus on service logic, policy rules, and citizen experience — rather than technical implementation.
* **Average time to launch a service: 1.5 months**
  Due to ready made components, you can devote most of the timeline to service design. Citizens will get essential, user-friendly services as quickly as possible.
* **Engineered for thousands of requests per second**
  Stay confident in stable service operation even during nationwide traffic peaks. Liquio’s microservices architecture automatically scales to meet demand.
* **Cost-efficient adaptability**
  Respond flexibly to legislative changes and update services without full rewrites—saving time and budget.  
* **Best-practice modules**
  Use ready-made components built on our extensive public-sector experience. Services are assembled through visual tools and configurable modules, reducing the need for complex custom programming.  
* **Multiple teams, parallel outcomes**
  Enable different teams to build and launch services simultaneously, accelerating digital transformation.  
* **Battle-tested in Ukraine**
  Liquio powers over 200 government IT solutions for national and municipal authorities.  
  One of the flagship cases is Diia — Ukraine’s national e-governance portal delivering used by over 23 million people.

# **Architecture**

Liquio is built as a set of microservices. See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) for the full breakdown of services, externally exposed APIs, the data layer, and a C4 container diagram of cross-service connections.

# **Trainings & Certifications**

We provide a certification program of Liquio technology for governmental teams and other IT companies. This growing Liquio partner network ensures on the one hand the ability to develop the solutions and create new services on the platform independently.

## **Roles we train:**

* Low-code developers
* Business analysts

## **Resources:**

- [Liquio website](https://www.liquio.tech/)
- [Kitsoft website](https://kitsoft.ua/)
- [Book a demo meeting](https://www.wixforms.com/f/7378205535620826264)

# **Contributing and Community**

We welcome contributions from the community! To get started:

- **[Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)**: Learn how to contribute to the project, including development setup, coding standards, and pull request process.
- **[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)**: Our community guidelines for respectful and inclusive interactions.
- **[Security Policy](SECURITY.md)**: Report security vulnerabilities and learn about our security practices.

services:
  id-front:
    build:
      context: ./components/id-front
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_ID_PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./config/id/config.json:/usr/share/nginx/html/config.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - id-api

  id-api:
    build:
      context: ./components/id-api
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_ID_API_PORT}:8100"
    volumes:
      - ./config/id:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - id-migrations
      - rabbitmq
      - redis

  id-migrations:
    build:
      context: ./components/id-api
    command: ["npm", "run", "migration-up"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/id:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres

  admin-api:
    build:
      context: ./components/admin-api
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_ADMIN_API_PORT}:8102"
    volumes:
      - ./config/admin-api:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - rabbitmq
      - redis

  admin-front:
    build:
      context: ./components/admin-front
      args:
        NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE: 1536
        GENERATE_SOURCEMAP: ${GENERATE_SOURCEMAP:-false}
        DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN: ${DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN:-true}
        INLINE_RUNTIME_CHUNK: ${INLINE_RUNTIME_CHUNK:-false}
      additional_contexts:
        core: ./packages/front-core
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_ADMIN_FRONT_PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./config/admin-front/config.json:/usr/share/nginx/html/config.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - admin-api

  cabinet-api:
    build:
      context: ./components/cabinet-api
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_CABINET_API_PORT}:8101"
    volumes:
      - ./config/cabinet-api:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - redis

  cabinet-front:
    build:
      context: ./components/cabinet-front
      args:
        NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE: 1536
        GENERATE_SOURCEMAP: ${GENERATE_SOURCEMAP:-false}
        DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN: ${DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN:-true}
        INLINE_RUNTIME_CHUNK: ${INLINE_RUNTIME_CHUNK:-false}
      additional_contexts:
        core: ./packages/front-core
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_CABINET_FRONT_PORT}:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./config/cabinet-front/config.json:/usr/share/nginx/html/config.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - cabinet-api

  manager-migrations:
    build:
      context: ./components/manager
    command: ["npm", "run", "migration-up"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/manager:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres

  manager:
    build:
      context: ./components/manager
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/manager:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - manager-migrations
      - rabbitmq
      - redis

  register:
    build:
      context: ./components/register
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_REGISTER_PORT}:8103"
    volumes:
      - ./config/register:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - register-migrations

  register-migrations:
    build:
      context: ./components/register
    command: ["npm", "run", "migration-up"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/register:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - rabbitmq
      - redis

  event-plugin-installer:
    build:
      context: ./components/event
    command: ["npm", "run", "plugin-installer"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/event:/var/www/config:ro
      - event-plugins:/var/www/plugins
    environment:
      PLUGINS_INSTALL_DIR: /var/www/plugins

  event:
    build:
      context: ./components/event
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/event:/var/www/config:ro
      - event-plugins:/var/www/plugins:ro
    depends_on:
      event-plugin-installer:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      postgres:
        condition: service_started
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_started
      redis:
        condition: service_started

  gateway:
    build:
      context: ./components/gateway
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/gateway:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - rabbitmq
      - redis

  sign-tool:
    build:
      context: ./components/sign-tool
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_SIGN_TOOL_PORT}:3004"
    volumes:
      - ./config/sign-tool:/var/www/config:ro

  task-plugin-installer:
    build:
      context: ./components/task
    command: ["npm", "run", "plugin-installer"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/task:/var/www/config:ro
      - task-plugins:/var/www/plugins
    environment:
      PLUGINS_INSTALL_DIR: /var/www/plugins

  task:
    build:
      context: ./components/task
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/task:/var/www/config:ro
      - task-plugins:/var/www/plugins:ro
    depends_on:
      task-plugin-installer:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      postgres:
        condition: service_started
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_started
      redis:
        condition: service_started

  notification:
    build:
      context: ./components/notification
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/notification:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - notification-migrations

  notification-migrations:
    build:
      context: ./components/notification
    command: ["npm", "run", "migration-up"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/notification:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres

  external-reader-plugin-installer:
    build:
      context: ./components/external-reader
    command: ["npm", "run", "plugin-installer"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/external-reader:/var/www/config:ro
      - external-reader-plugins:/var/www/plugins
    environment:
      PLUGINS_INSTALL_DIR: /var/www/plugins

  external-reader:
    build:
      context: ./components/external-reader
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_EXTERNAL_READER_PORT}:8104"
    volumes:
      - ./config/external-reader:/var/www/config:ro
      - external-reader-plugins:/var/www/plugins:ro
    depends_on:
      external-reader-plugin-installer:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  pdf-generator:
    build:
      context: ./components/pdf-generator
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_PDF_GENERATOR_PORT}:7007"
    volumes:
      - ./config/pdf-generator:/var/www/config:ro

  filestorage:
    build:
      context: ./components/filestorage
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_FILESTORAGE_PORT}:8105"
    volumes:
      - ./config/filestorage:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - filestorage-migrations

  filestorage-migrations:
    build:
      context: ./components/filestorage
    command: ["npm", "run", "migration-up"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/filestorage:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres

  persist-link-migrations:
    build:
      context: ./components/persist-link
    command: ["npm", "run", "migration-up"]
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./config/persist-link:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - postgres

  persist-link:
    build:
      context: ./components/persist-link
    restart: on-failure
    ports:
      - "${SVC_PERSIST_LINK_PORT}:3346"
    volumes:
      - ./config/persist-link:/var/www/config:ro
    depends_on:
      - persist-link-migrations
      - postgres

  postgres:
    image: postgres:17
    ports:
      - "${POSTGRES_PUBLISHED_PORT:-5432}:5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_HOST: ${POSTGRES_HOST}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_NAME: ${POSTGRES_NAME}
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./init/db/:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management
    ports:
      - "${RABBITMQ_MANAGEMENT_PUBLISHED_PORT:-15672}:15672"
      - "${RABBITMQ_AMQP_PUBLISHED_PORT:-5672}:5672"
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: ${RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER}
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: ${RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS}
    volumes:
      - rabbitmq_data:/var/lib/rabbitmq
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "status"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  redis:
    image: redis:latest
    ports:
      - "${REDIS_PUBLISHED_PORT:-6379}:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  rabbitmq_data:
  redis_data:
  event-plugins:
  external-reader-plugins:
  task-plugins:

observation.command: cat README.md && echo "=====" && ls scripts && echo "=====" && cat docker-compose.yml
